summary: Fix finite-set complements by distinguishing true, false, and undecidable membership. Preserve unknown elements in an unevaluated Complement and union them with known outside elements; remove the interval numeric-only guard so symbolic assumptions use the same logic. Added regression coverage for the reported mixed set, substitutions, outside numbers, symbolic expressions, assumptions, and integer complements. Reproduced original {x, y} output and observed new regression fail before fix. Public test command /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python bin/test sympy/sets/tests --no-colors --no-subprocess passed: 117 passed, 3 expected failures. Reviewed final diff.
